== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Councilors]] are the leaders of the [[Consultant's Guild]] and serve as the voice for the [[Am’haranai]]. Composed of three members known as [[Architects]], they view themselves as the foundational designers and protectors of The Empire{{!}}the Empire, acting as shepherds for its people. While many [[Architects]] remain unseen or unknown, one prominent member is [[Yala the High Mason]]. The [[Council]] operates with significant Authority{{!}}authority, making strategic decisions regarding the stability of The Empire{{!}}the Empire and its leadership. Following the death of the Emperor, the [[Council]] has engaged in efforts to dismantle his global network and has debated whether to maintain the [[throne]] or support a [[Regent]]. Their primary objective is to manage the threat posed by the [[Great Elders]], whom they aim to contain or combat using various assets, such as the [[Regents]], to prevent the total collapse of the world.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Councilors]] are a group mentioned by [[Shera]], which includes three members who represent the Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild. During his own reflections, [[Lucan]] suspected that these councilors might be driven by selfish motivations. In preparation for upcoming events, [[Lucan]] drafted letters intended for the group. Ultimately, three of these High [[Councilors]] were present at the front of [[Shera]]'s meeting.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] considered that the High [[Councilors]] might have had selfish motivations.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
